postprocess_qa_predictions: postprocess question answering model predictions to convert start and end logits into answer text substrings from original contexts
post_processing_function_qa: post process QA predictions and format them into EvalPrediction objects ready for SQUAD metric evaluation
compute_metrics: compute SQUAD or SQUAD v2 evaluation metrics like exact match and F1 score for a question answering model
create_model_card: create a Hugging Face model card with validation metrics and usage examples for a trained question answering model
prepare_qa_validation_features: prepare and tokenize question answering validation data with offset mappings for extracting answer spans from contexts
